definitions.explanation: The process of sending data, signals, or information from one point to another through a communication channel or medium.

examples.japanese: データの{伝送|でんそう}が{完了|かんりょう}した。
{光|ひかり}ファイバーによる{高速|こうそく}{伝送|でんそう}が{普及|ふきゅう}している。
examples.english: High-speed transmission via fiber optics is becoming widespread.

examples.japanese: {伝送|でんそう}{速度|そくど}が{遅|おそ}いと、{動画|どうが}の{再生|さいせい}が{途切|とぎ}れてしまうことがある。
examples.english: When the transmission speed is slow, video playback can get interrupted.

notes:
A technical term primarily used in telecommunications and information technology. Composed of {伝|でん} (transmit; convey) + {送|そう} (send). Focuses specifically on the movement of data or signals through a medium, as opposed to the broader concept of communication.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {伝送|でんそう}{速度|そくど}: transmission speed
- {伝送|でんそう}{路|ろ}: transmission path; channel
- {伝送|でんそう}{方式|ほうしき}: transmission method
- データ{伝送|でんそう}: data transmission
- {無線|むせん}{伝送|でんそう}: wireless transmission

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {送信|そうしん}: sending; transmitting — the act of sending from the sender's side
- {通信|つうしん}: communication; telecommunications — broader term covering both sending and receiving
- {転送|てんそう}: forwarding; transfer — relaying data or messages to another destination
